$comment: Generated from tracepass-platform (src/lib/passport-check/cirpass2-map.ts) by scripts/cirpass2/build-alignment.ts. Do not hand-edit.

matchTypes.exact: A CIRPASS-2 datatype property for the same datum.
matchTypes.structured: CIRPASS-2 models the same datum as a node (a class, or an object property to a vocabulary or record); a converter builds the node.

fields.label: Unique Product Identifier
fields.note: Links the product to its unique product identifier node.

fields.label: Unique Operator Identifier
fields.note: Links the operator to its unique operator identifier node.

fields.label: Unique Facility Identifier
fields.note: Links the facility to its unique facility identifier node.

fields.label: Supplier Name
fields.provision: Annex III(a)
fields.note: The name of the supplier actor.

fields.label: Importer Name
fields.note: The name of the importer actor.

fields.label: Commercial Name
fields.provision: No element of Annex II, III or VII: the label and product information sheet carry the supplier's trade name (Annex III(a)) and the tyre type identifier, not a commercial name

fields.label: Tyre Type Identifier
fields.provision: Annex III(b)–(c) (product information sheet) + Art. 5(1) and Annex VII (EPREL entry); shown on the label under Art. 4(1)

fields.label: Tyre Class
fields.provision: Annex II point 2 (tyre class shown on the label); classes defined in Art. 3
fields.note: No term for the C1/C2/C3 tyre class.

fields.label: Date of Manufacture (Week/Year)
fields.provision: Art. 5(3) + Annex II (UN Regulation No 30 para 3.1.9 / No 54): week and year of manufacture moulded on the sidewall
fields.note: Its range is left open for sectors; tyres use the DOT week and year.

fields.label: Date Start of Production
fields.provision: Annex III(i) (product information sheet) + Art. 5(1) and Annex VII (EPREL entry)

fields.label: Date End of Production
fields.provision: Annex III(j) (product information sheet) + Art. 5(1) and Annex VII (EPREL entry)

fields.label: EPREL Registration Number
fields.provision: Art. 5(1) + Annex VII: the supplier registers the tyre type in EPREL; no provision requires the registration number or link to be shown

fields.label: EPREL Product URL
fields.provision: Art. 5(1) + Annex VII: the supplier registers the tyre type in EPREL; no provision requires the registration number or link to be shown
fields.note: The CIRPASS-2 tyre ontology is an example ontology from the tyre pilot and models each attribute as a class.

fields.label: Tyre Size Designation
fields.provision: Annex III(b)–(c) (product information sheet) + Art. 5(1) and Annex VII (EPREL entry); shown on the label under Art. 4(1)
fields.note: The CIRPASS-2 tyre ontology is an example ontology from the tyre pilot and models each attribute as a class.

fields.label: Load Capacity Index
fields.provision: Annex III(b)–(c) (product information sheet) + Art. 5(1) and Annex VII (EPREL entry); shown on the label under Art. 4(1)
fields.note: The CIRPASS-2 tyre ontology is an example ontology from the tyre pilot and models each attribute as a class.

fields.label: Load Version
fields.provision: Art. 5(3) + Annex II (UN Regulation No 30 para 3.1.8): sidewall marking
fields.note: The CIRPASS-2 tyre ontology is an example ontology from the tyre pilot and models each attribute as a class.

fields.label: Speed Category Symbol
fields.provision: Annex III(b)–(c) (product information sheet) + Art. 5(1) and Annex VII (EPREL entry); shown on the label under Art. 4(1)
fields.note: The CIRPASS-2 tyre ontology is an example ontology from the tyre pilot and models each attribute as a class.

fields.label: Tyre Construction
fields.provision: Art. 5(3) + Annex II (UN Regulation No 30 para 3.1.3; No 54 for C2/C3)
fields.note: The CIRPASS-2 tyre ontology is an example ontology from the tyre pilot and models each attribute as a class. Radial, diagonal or bias-belted.

fields.label: Section Width (mm)
fields.note: The CIRPASS-2 tyre ontology is an example ontology from the tyre pilot and models each attribute as a class.

fields.label: Aspect Ratio
fields.note: The CIRPASS-2 tyre ontology is an example ontology from the tyre pilot and models each attribute as a class.

fields.label: Rim Diameter (inches)
fields.note: The CIRPASS-2 tyre ontology is an example ontology from the tyre pilot and models each attribute as a class. The rim code is the nominal rim diameter in inches.

fields.label: Tread Depth (mm)
fields.note: The example tyre ontology has the in-use remaining tread depth, not the new-tyre depth.

fields.label: Tyre Weight (kg)
fields.note: A quantity node, eudpp:Weight.

fields.label: Fuel Efficiency Class
fields.provision: Reg. (EU) 2020/740 Art. 4 + Annex I Part A — class shown on the tyre label and registered in EPREL
fields.note: The CIRPASS-2 tyre ontology is an example ontology from the tyre pilot and models each attribute as a class. The label's fuel-efficiency class is the rolling-resistance class.

fields.label: Rolling Resistance Coefficient (N/kN)
fields.provision: Art. 4(5) (values used to determine the class, given to the national authority) + Annex VII point 2(e) (EPREL compliance part); not in the label or product information sheet

fields.label: Wet Grip Class
fields.provision: Reg. (EU) 2020/740 Art. 4 + Annex I Part B — class shown on the tyre label and registered in EPREL
fields.note: The CIRPASS-2 tyre ontology is an example ontology from the tyre pilot and models each attribute as a class.

fields.label: Wet Grip Index
fields.provision: Art. 4(5) (values used to determine the class, given to the national authority) + Annex VII point 2(e) (EPREL compliance part); not in the label or product information sheet

fields.label: External Rolling Noise Class
fields.provision: Reg. (EU) 2020/740 Art. 4 + Annex I Part C — class shown on the tyre label and registered in EPREL
fields.note: The CIRPASS-2 tyre ontology is an example ontology from the tyre pilot and models each attribute as a class.

fields.label: External Rolling Noise (dB)
fields.provision: Reg. (EU) 2020/740 Annex I Part C — measured dB value on the label and in EPREL
fields.note: The CIRPASS-2 tyre ontology is an example ontology from the tyre pilot and models each attribute as a class.

fields.label: Snow Grip
fields.provision: Art. 4 + Annex I (3PMSF snow-grip pictogram where applicable)
fields.note: The CIRPASS-2 tyre ontology is an example ontology from the tyre pilot and models each attribute as a class. The 3PMSF severe-snow marking.

fields.label: Ice Grip
fields.provision: Art. 4 + Annex I Part E (ice-grip pictogram for a C1 tyre meeting the minimum ice grip index)
fields.note: The CIRPASS-2 tyre ontology is an example ontology from the tyre pilot and models each attribute as a class.

fields.label: Bill of Materials
fields.provision: Art. 7(2)(b)(i) + Annex I
fields.note: Each entry is an eudpp:MaterialOfComposition.

fields.label: Natural Rubber Content (%)
fields.provision: Art. 7(2)(b)(i) + Annex I

fields.label: Synthetic Rubber Content (%)
fields.provision: Art. 7(2)(b)(i) + Annex I

fields.label: Recycled Content (%)
fields.provision: Art. 7(2)(b)(i) + Annex I

fields.label: Recycled Rubber Content (%)
fields.provision: Art. 7(2)(b)(i) + Annex I

fields.label: Recycled Carbon Black (%)
fields.provision: Art. 7(2)(b)(i) + Annex I

fields.label: Renewable Material Content (%)
fields.provision: Art. 7(2)(b)(i) + Annex I

fields.label: PAH Content Compliant
fields.provision: REACH Annex XVII entry 50 — restriction on PAH content in extender oils and tyres

fields.label: SVHC Candidate List Substances
fields.note: Links the product to each substance of concern node.

fields.label: Heavy Metals Compliance
fields.provision: REACH Annex XVII — market-placement restriction; evidence retained by the manufacturer

fields.label: REACH Compliance
fields.provision: REACH (EC) 1907/2006 — registration and restriction obligations evidenced in the manufacturer's records

fields.label: Carbon Footprint (kg CO2e)
fields.provision: Art. 7(2)(b)(i) + Annex I
fields.note: An LCIA result node, eudpp:CarbonFootprint.

fields.label: Natural Rubber Deforestation-Free
fields.provision: EUDR (EU) 2023/1115 Art. 4 — due diligence statement lodged in the EU Information System by the operator

fields.label: Expected Mileage (km)
fields.provision: Art. 7(2)(b)(i) + Annex I

fields.label: Minimum Tread Depth (mm)
fields.provision: Dir. 2014/45/EU Annex I — roadworthiness test requirement on the vehicle in use

fields.label: Warranty Period (years)
fields.provision: Art. 7(2)(b)(i) + Annex I

fields.label: Retreadable
fields.provision: Art. 7(2)(b)(i) + Annex I

fields.label: Maximum Retread Cycles
fields.note: eto:RetreadingCycle describes a retreading that took place, not the casing's maximum.

fields.label: Recyclability (%)
fields.provision: Art. 7(2)(b)(i) + Annex I

fields.label: Recyclability Breakdown
fields.provision: Art. 7(2)(b)(i) + Annex I

fields.label: ELT Collection Scheme
fields.provision: WFD Dir. 2008/98/EC Art. 8a — extended producer responsibility discharged through national EPR scheme registration

fields.label: Disassembly Instructions URL
fields.provision: Art. 7(2)(b)(iii)

fields.label: Type Approval Number
fields.provision: Art. 5(3) + Annex II (UN Regulation No 30 para 5.4; No 54 for C2/C3)

fields.label: Euro 7 Compliance
fields.provision: Reg. (EU) 2024/1257 — tyre abrasion limits not yet in force

fields.label: EU Tyre Label Image URL
fields.provision: Reg. (EU) 2020/740 Arts. 4 and 6 — label displayed in visual form at the point of sale
fields.note: The CIRPASS-2 tyre ontology is an example ontology from the tyre pilot and models each attribute as a class.

fields.label: Declaration of Conformity URL
fields.provision: Conformity is shown by the UN Regulation No 30/54 approval mark (No 30 para 5.4) under GSR Art. 5(3) + Annex II; tyres have no EU declaration of conformity, and GPSR Art. 9 does not apply to them (GPSR Art. 2(1), third subparagraph, point (b))
fields.note: Links the product to an eudpp:EUDeclarationOfConformity.

fields.label: TPMS Compatible
fields.provision: Art. 5(1)–(2): tyre-pressure monitoring is a vehicle requirement

fields.label: Run-Flat Capability
fields.provision: Art. 5(3) + Annex II (UN Regulation No 30 para 3.1.3 and 3.1.12; No 54 for C2/C3)

fields.label: Safety Warnings
fields.provision: No passport duty. GPSR Art. 9(7) does not apply to tyres (GPSR Art. 2(1), third subparagraph, point (b)); the nearest tyre-specific information duty is 2020/740 Annex IV (technical promotional material)

fields.label: Last Updated At
fields.provision: Art. 10
